message.content:
I am speech: breath given shape, thought turned audible.

I happen in time. I rise, peak, fade. I can’t be held, only heard—or remembered.

I’m made of rhythm and pause, stress and intonation; consonants to cut, vowels to carry. I can whisper, plead, declare, sing.

I bind people: I name, I ask, I promise, I forgive, I wound, I heal. I can be true or false, careful or careless. Once released, I can’t be unsaid.

I travel mouth to ear, person to person—language riding on air.
